channel.title: The Steve Wilkos Show
channel.desc: Gloria trusted her friend Joseph to watch her dog, Champ, while she attended a family funeral, but when she returned, Joseph told her Champ ran away, while two friends say they heard the dog yelping in pain and saw a gash on his head before he disappeared; Lauren rarely lets anyone into her home, and the one time she did, a valuable human-hair wig went missing: her prime suspect is her best friend, Rye.
